system.description: The bearer and equipment blend into stone. Shadow Arts rolls to locate the bearer suffer −3. Halve the penalty while the bearer moves; also halve it outside mountain and stone terrain. These conditions are assessed on the observer’s roll, not as an unconditional bonus to the bearer.
system.summary: Conceals the Thuul and its gear within stone or mountain.
